author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA+DAQB with inverse-distance weights (δ=0.12,kd=22,k=50,γ_max=0.70)
abstract: Alternative to exp-weights: w_ij = 1/(1 + d_ij/median(d_nonzero)) on DAQB graph from the frozen baseline (kd=22,k=50,δ=0.12,γ_max=0.70,emb_k=17). Tests if a gentler taper improves label metrics without harming PCR/cLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
import scipy.sparse as sp
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])

from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run
from weighting_connectivities import distance_weight_connectivities

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Run frozen-baseline config
    adata = _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
    # Post-process: inverse-distance weights (symmetric)
    D = adata.obsp['distances'].tocsr()
    W = distance_weight_connectivities(D, scheme="inv", scale="median", alpha=1.0)
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = W
    adata.uns['neighbors'] = {
        'connectivities_key': 'connectivities',
        'distances_key': 'distances',
        'params': {
            'n_neighbors': 50,
            'method': 'daqb+distance_weight_inv',
            'metric': 'cosine',
            'kdensity': 22,
            'delta': 0.12,
            'gamma_max': 0.70
        }
    }
    return adata
